quarterly_data.quarter: Grace Fabric Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Mao Jiaming and the company (H1 2026 results briefing): E-glass fabric was 65% of H1 2026 revenue and specialty electronic fabric 35%. Specialty fabric prices were rising in Q2 and the company will keep negotiating prices with customers in H2; as specialty fabric capacity keeps expanding, the company expects gross margin is likely to keep rising in H2. With no capacity added this year, it will grow 2026 revenue and net profit through product-mix changes, cutting output of thin, thick and special E-glass fabrics and raising specialty fabric output.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue mix: E-glass fabric 65%, specialty electronic fabric 35%

quarterly_data.quarter: Grace Fabric Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Mao Jiaming and the company (H1 2026 results briefing): market conditions in H1 2026 beat H1 2025, with industry prices recovering and products in short supply; demand for low-Dk and low-CTE specialty fabrics is strong, driven mainly by growth in high-end server shipments, with some growth in consumer electronics and automotive electronics. Capacity of E-glass, generation-1, generation-2 and T fabrics is flexed to customer orders; capacity will not increase this year, and new capacity at subsidiary Huangshi Grace is expected to be released next year (2027), for which the company has pre-booked equipment, so it expects no equipment or electronic-yarn bottleneck. It mainly self-supplies E-glass ultra-fine, extra-fine and specialty yarn, the share of purchased yarn is falling as its yarn capacity expands, and Huangshi's high-end specialty yarn keeps expanding according to customer orders.
quarterly_data.figure: Huangshi Grace new capacity expected in 2027

quarterly_data.quarter: Grace Fabric Technology results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Mao Jiaming (H1 2026 results briefing): the company's quartz fabric (Q fabric) has passed certification and the company is ready for mass production, waiting for downstream customer demand to ramp. Director and CFO Huang Yujia said the raw material of its quartz fabric is quartz fibre, whose price has not fluctuated much.
